cards.name: Pansage
cards.description: It shares the leaf on its head with weary-looking Pokémon. These leaves are known to relieve stress.

cards.name: Tauros
cards.description: After heightening its will to fight by whipping itself with its three tails, it charges at full speed.

cards.name: Dunsparce
cards.description: When spotted, this Pokémon escapes backwards by furiously boring into the ground with its tail.

cards.name: Taillow
cards.description: It has a gutsy spirit that makes it bravely take on tough foes. It flies in search of warm climates.

cards.name: Swellow
cards.description: If its two tail feathers are standing at attention, it is proof of good health. It soars elegantly in the sky.

cards.name: Skitty
cards.description: It can't stop itself from chasing moving things, and it runs in a circle, chasing its own tail.

cards.name: Delcatty
cards.description: It dislikes dirty places. It often searches for a comfortable place in which to groom itself.

cards.name: Bidoof
cards.description: With nerves of steel, nothing can perturb it. It is more agile and active than it appears.

cards.name: Bibarel
cards.description: It busily makes its nest with stacks of branches and roots it has cut up with its sharp incisors.

cards.name: Lillipup
cards.description: The long hair around its face provides an amazing radar that lets it sense subtle changes in its surroundings.

cards.name: Herdier
cards.description: This very loyal Pokémon helps Trainers, and it also takes care of other Pokémon.

cards.name: Simisage
cards.description: It attacks enemies with strikes of its thorn-covered tail. This Pokémon is wild tempered.

cards.name: Stoutland
cards.description: It rescues people stranded by blizzards in the mountains. Its shaggy fur shields it from the cold.

cards.name: Bunnelby
cards.description: They use their large ears to dig burrows. They will dig the whole night through.

cards.name: Diggersby
cards.description: With their powerful ears, they can heft boulders of a ton or more with ease. They can be a big help at construction sites.

cards.name: Fletchling
cards.description: These friendly Pokémon send signals to one another with beautiful chirps and tail-feather movements.

cards.name: Furfrou
cards.description: Trimming its fluffy fur not only makes it more elegant but also increases the swiftness of its movements.

cards.name: Chespin
cards.description: The quills on its head are usually soft. When it flexes them, the points become so hard and sharp that they can pierce rock.

cards.name: Quilladin
cards.description: It relies on its sturdy shell to deflect predators' attacks. It counterattacks with its sharp quills.

cards.name: Chesnaught
cards.description: Its Tackle is forceful enough to flip a 50-ton tank. It shields its allies from danger with its own body.

cards.name: Scatterbug
cards.description: When under attack from bird Pokémon, it spews a poisonous black powder that causes paralysis on contact.

cards.name: Spewpa
cards.description: It lives hidden within thicket shadows. When predators attack, it quickly bristles the fur covering its body in an effort to threaten them.

cards.name: Vivillon
cards.description: Vivillon with many different patterns are found all over the world. These patterns are affected by the climate of their habitat.

cards.name: Skiddo
cards.description: Thought to be one of the first Pokémon to live in harmony with humans, it has a placid disposition.

cards.name: Gogoat
cards.description: It can tell how its trainer is feeling by subtle shifts in the grip on its horns. This empathetic sense lets them run as if one being.

cards.name: Slugma
cards.description: A common sight in volcanic areas, it slowly slithers around in a constant search for warm places.

cards.name: Magcargo
cards.description: Its brittle shell occasionally spouts intense flames that circulate throughout its body.

cards.name: Pansear
cards.description: Very intelligent, it roasts berries before eating them. It likes to help people.

cards.name: Simisear
cards.description: A flame burns inside its body. It scatters embers from its head and tail to sear its opponents.

cards.name: Fennekin
cards.description: Eating a twig fills it with energy, and its roomy ears give vent to air hotter than 390 degrees Fahrenheit.

cards.name: Braixen
cards.description: It has a twig stuck in its tail. With friction from its tail fur, it sets the twig on fire and launches into battle.

cards.name: Delphox
cards.description: It gazes into the flame at the tip of its branch to achieve a focused state, which allows it to see into the future.

cards.name: Fletchinder
cards.description: From its beak, it expels embers that set the tall grass on fire. Then it pounces on the bewildered prey that pop out of the grass.

cards.name: Talonflame
cards.description: In the fever of an exciting battle, it showers embers from the gaps between its feathers and takes to the air.

cards.name: Weedle
cards.description: Often found in forests and grasslands. It has a sharp, toxic barb of around two inches on top of its head.

cards.name: Shellder
cards.description: Its hard shell repels any kind of attack. It is vulnerable only when its shell is open.

cards.name: Cloyster
cards.description: Cloyster that live in seas with harsh tidal currents grow large, sharp spikes on their shells.

cards.name: Staryu
cards.description: Even if its body is torn, it can regenerate as long as the glowing central core remains intact.

cards.name: Starmie
cards.description: Its central core glows with the seven colors of the rainbow. Some people value the core as a gem.

cards.name: Lapras
cards.description: They have gentle hearts. Because they rarely fight, many have been caught. Their number has dwindled.

cards.name: Corsola
cards.description: It continuously sheds and grows. The tip of its head is prized as a treasure because of its beauty.

cards.name: Panpour
cards.description: The water stored inside the tuft on its head is full of nutrients. It waters plants with it using its tail.

cards.name: Simipour
cards.description: The high-pressure water expelled from its tail is so powerful, it can destroy a concrete wall.

cards.name: Froakie
cards.description: It secretes flexible bubbles from its chest and back. The bubbles reduce the damage it would otherwise take when attacked.

cards.name: Kakuna
cards.description: Almost incapable of moving, this Pokémon can only harden its shell to protect itself when it is in danger.

cards.name: Frogadier
cards.description: It can throw bubble-covered pebbles with precise control, hitting empty cans up to a hundred feet away.

cards.name: Greninja
cards.description: It creates throwing stars out of compressed water. When it spins them and throws them at high speed, these stars can split metal in two.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.description: It raises its tail to check its surroundings. The tail is sometimes struck by lightning in this pose.

cards.name: Raichu
cards.description: When its electricity builds, its muscles are stimulated, and it becomes more aggressive than usual.

cards.name: Voltorb
cards.description: It was discovered when Poké Balls were introduced. It is said that there is some connection.

cards.name: Electrode
cards.description: It explodes in response to even minor stimuli. It is feared, with the nickname of "The Bomb Ball."

cards.name: Ekans
cards.description: The older it gets, the longer it grows. At night, it wraps its long body around tree branches to rest.

cards.name: Arbok
cards.description: The pattern on its belly appears to be a frightening face. Weak foes will flee just at the sight of the pattern.

cards.name: Spoink
cards.description: It bounces constantly, using its tail like a spring. The shock of bouncing keeps its heart beating.

cards.name: Beedrill
cards.description: It has three poisonous stingers on its forelegs and its tail. They are used to jab its enemy repeatedly.

cards.name: Grumpig
cards.description: It uses black pearls to amplify its psychic power. It does a strange dance to control foes' minds.

cards.name: Venipede
cards.description: It discovers what is going on around it by using the feelers on its head and tail. It is brutally aggressive.

cards.name: Whirlipede
cards.description: Protected by a hard shell, it spins its body like a wheel and crashes furiously into its enemies.

cards.name: Scolipede
cards.description: It clasps its prey with the claws on its neck until it stops moving. Then it finishes it off with deadly poison.

cards.name: Phantump
cards.description: These Pokémon are created when spirits possess rotten tree stumps. They prefer to live in abandoned forests.

cards.name: Trevenant
cards.description: It can control trees at will. It will trap people who harm the forest, so they can never leave.

cards.name: Pumpkaboo
cards.description: The pumpkin body is inhabited by a spirit trapped in this world. As the sun sets, it becomes restless and active.

cards.name: Gourgeist
cards.description: Singing in eerie voices, they wander town streets on the night of the new moon. Anyone who hears their song is cursed.

cards.name: Diglett
cards.description: Lives about one yard underground where it feeds on plant roots. It sometimes appears aboveground.

cards.name: Dugtrio
cards.description: In battle, it digs through the ground and strikes the unsuspecting foe from an unexpected direction.

cards.name: Ledyba
cards.description: When the weather turns cold, lots of Ledyba gather from everywhere to cluster and keep each other warm.

cards.name: Rhyhorn
cards.description: Strong, but not too bright, this Pokémon can shatter even a skyscraper with its charging Tackles.

cards.name: Rhydon
cards.description: Protected by an armor-like hide, it is capable of living in molten lava of 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit.

cards.name: Rhyperior
cards.description: From holes in its palms, it fires out Geodude. Its carapace can withstand volcanic eruptions.

cards.name: Lunatone
cards.description: Because it turns active on nights of the full moon, it is said to have some link to the lunar phases.

cards.name: Solrock
cards.description: Solar energy is the source of its power, so it is strong during the daytime. When it spins, its body shines.

cards.name: Timburr
cards.description: These Pokémon appear at building sites and help out with construction. They always carry squared logs.

cards.name: Gurdurr
cards.description: With strengthened bodies, they skillfully wield steel beams to take down buildings.

cards.name: Conkeldurr
cards.description: It is thought that Conkeldurr taught humans how to make concrete more than 2,000 years ago.

cards.name: Sableye
cards.description: It hides in the darkness of caves. Its diet of gems has transformed its eyes into gemstones.

cards.name: Sandile
cards.description: It moves along below the sand's surface, except for its nose and eyes. A dark membrane shields its eyes from the sun.

cards.name: Ledian
cards.description: When the stars flicker in the night sky, it flutters about, scattering a glowing powder.

cards.name: Krokorok
cards.description: They live in groups of a few individuals. Protective membranes shield their eyes from sandstorms.

cards.name: Krookodile
cards.description: Very violent Pokémon, they try to clamp down on anything that moves in front of their eyes.

cards.name: Zorua
cards.description: It changes so it looks like its foe, tricks it, and then uses that opportunity to flee.

cards.name: Zoroark
cards.description: Each has the ability to fool a large group of people simultaneously. They protect their lair with illusory scenery.

cards.name: Inkay
cards.description: Opponents who stare at the flashing of the light-emitting spots on its body become dazed and lose their will to fight.

cards.name: Inkay
cards.description: Opponents who stare at the flashing of the light-emitting spots on its body become dazed and lose their will to fight.

cards.name: Malamar
cards.description: It wields the most compelling hypnotic powers of any Pokémon, and it forces others to do whatever it wants.

cards.name: Malamar
cards.description: It wields the most compelling hypnotic powers of any Pokémon, and it forces others to do whatever it wants.

cards.name: Yveltal
cards.description: When this legendary Pokémon's wings and tail feathers spread wide and glow red, it absorbs the life force of all living creatures.

cards.name: Volbeat
cards.description: It communicates with others by lighting up its rear at night. It loves Illumise's sweet aroma.

cards.name: Pawniard
cards.description: Blades comprise this Pokémon's entire body. If battling dulls the blades, it sharpens them on stones by the river.

cards.name: Bisharp
cards.description: This pitiless Pokémon commands a group of Pawniard to hound prey into immobility. It then moves in to finish the prey off.

cards.name: Honedge
cards.description: Apparently this Pokémon is born when a departed spirit inhabits a sword. It attaches itself to people and drinks their life force.

cards.name: Doublade
cards.description: When Honedge evolves, it divides into two swords, which cooperate via telepathy to coordinate attacks and slash their enemies to ribbons.

cards.name: Aegislash
cards.description: Generations of kings were attended by these Pokémon, which used their spectral power to manipulate and control people and Pokémon.

cards.name: Aegislash
cards.description: Generations of kings were attended by these Pokémon, which used their spectral power to manipulate and control people and Pokémon.

cards.name: Jigglypuff
cards.description: It captivates foes with its huge, round eyes, then lulls them to sleep by singing a soothing melody.

cards.name: Jigglypuff
cards.description: It captivates foes with its huge, round eyes, then lulls them to sleep by singing a soothing melody.

cards.name: Wigglytuff
cards.description: Their fur feels so good that if two of them snuggle together, they won't want to be separated.

cards.name: Illumise
cards.description: Its fragrance attracts a swarm of Volbeat, so they draw over 200 patterns in the night sky.

cards.name: Wigglytuff
cards.description: Their fur feels so good that if two of them snuggle together, they won't want to be separated.

cards.name: Mr. Mime
cards.description: Emanations from its fingertips solidify the air into invisible walls that repel even harsh attacks.

cards.name: Spritzee
cards.description: It emits a scent that enraptures those who smell it. This fragrance changes depending on what it has eaten.

cards.name: Aromatisse
cards.description: It devises various scents, pleasant and unpleasant, and emits scents that its enemies dislike in order to gain an edge in battle.

cards.name: Swirlix
cards.description: To entangle its opponents in battle, it extrudes white threads as sweet and as sticky as cotton candy.

cards.name: Slurpuff
cards.description: It can distinguish the faintest of scents. It puts its sensitive sense of smell to use by helping pastry chefs in their work.

cards.name: Xerneas
cards.description: Legends say it can share eternal life. It slept for a thousand years in the form of a tree before its revival.

cards.name: Doduo
cards.description: A two-headed Pokémon that was discovered as a sudden mutation. It runs at a pace of over 60 miles per hour.

cards.name: Dodrio
cards.description: An enemy that takes its eyes off any of the three heads—even for a second—will get pecked severely.
